Hoggart was replaced by Sandi Toksvig in September 2006 , who in turn was replaced by Miles Jupp in September 2015 until his departure at the end of 2019 . Three different hosts took the chair in 2020 , Nish Kumar ( series 101 ) , Angela Barnes ( series 102 ) , and Andy Zaltzman ( series 103 ) . At the end of series 103 it was announced that Zaltzman would continue as permanent host . The series was created by John Lloyd based on an idea from Nicholas Parsons .
